STATE: Ned went to psychiatrist March 12 (moved up from March 19). Outcome: no bupropion. Doctor wants ADHD testing first.

TESTING: March 19, 10:30am. Requires mom as collateral informant (childhood behavioral reference).

PROBLEM WITH MOM: Ned expects her to perform 'good mom' rather than give honest data. She'll say he was disciplined, perfect, never a problem — which is accurate for surface presentation but misses the masking. Ned is protective of her and won't expose childhood trauma context.

STRATEGY: Set boundary with psychiatrist BEFORE mom enters room: 'I've shared private things with you. Don't bring up trauma or personal history in front of her. This session is about childhood ADHD symptoms only.'

KEY TALKING POINT: 'I masked. My mom confirms the surface presentation. That's exactly the problem.'

NED'S CONCERN: Worried about exaggerating symptoms because he knows he's being tested and can present however he wants after 25 years of masking. Decided to give real data and let doctor decide.

BACKUP: If diagnosis doesn't come through, Ned is considering sourcing modafinil independently rather than waiting.
